scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen eighty-four... the Washington Monument was finally finished.

scenes.label: Washington, D.C.
scenes.caption: The unfinished shaft, early 1880s
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Work began in eighteen forty-eight... but it sat unfinished for over twenty years.

scenes.label: tall when the capstone was set
scenes.text: [calmly] Workers set its capstone, five hundred fifty-five feet up.

scenes.label: The aluminum tip
scenes.caption: Photo by Theodor Horydczak, 1934
scenes.text: [softly] Its tip was made of aluminum, then a rare metal.

scenes.title: Tallest structure on Earth
scenes.text: [warmly] It became the tallest structure on Earth, until the Eiffel Tower.

scenes.title: Have you seen it in person?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you ever seen it in person?
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
